# `get_wheel_slot_name`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Return the filter-wheel slot names.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | method (client sends) |
| Grade | PURE GETTER / probable (64-bit and 32-bit builds) |
| Side-effect tier | A |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, handler @0xb3e90, GetSlotName @0x301110 (64-bit build) |

Reads no parameters. The result is a string array of the in-memory slot-name map values in ascending key order; the keys are not returned. An empty map gives an empty array. No wheel needs to be open.

Side effects: Serialises a reference to the in-memory slot-name map; no writes, no wait, no opened-wheel requirement.

## Example

Request, request:

```json
{"id":101,"method":"get_wheel_slot_name"}
```

Reply, ok:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"get_wheel_slot_name","result":["Dark","IR cut","Light pollution"],"code":0,"id":101}
```
